title: Review-packet skill
summary: Assemble a concise review result that points to actual artifacts.

sections.label: Inputs
sections.text: Task contract, final revision, diff, commands/pipeline reports, findings, source versions, and exclusions.

sections.label: Output
sections.text: Concrete behavior change, scope, verification, evidence links, unresolved issues, and appropriate verdict.

sections.label: Acceptance
sections.text: Descriptions reflect the final change. Actual executed results are distinguishable from intended checks, and skipped/unsupported checks remain visible.

catalog.applicability: Use this explanation to inform decisions. Confirm its fit with your actual environment.
catalog.limits: Reading a topic does not configure tools, execute a workflow or establish passing evidence.
